title: Stack plan per lot (step 6.7)
description: Levels relative to grade, height budget against the angled envelope plane and the stage each selected area-matrix cell reached (S0 levels and height; S1 stair and plane-limited polygons; S2 upper-floor zoning). Stage S1 adds the optional `s1` block per two-floor cell (additive within contract 0.2.0); stage S1.1 adds the stair core and the rule traces. Stage S2 adds the optional `s2` block per drawn cell: zoning of both floors around the stair core, the A/B/C start portfolio and the client-rule traces (additive within 0.2.0).

polygon.description: GeoJSON-like polygon in the lot's world coordinates (as lot_capacity).

s1.description: Stage S1 of a two-floor cell: drawn ground and upper floors, stand-in garage, stair at the joint, allowed polygon per level (131.0444), roof of the drawn upper floor against the plane, containment and room over the garage (R302.6). Stage S1.2: the stair is placed from the main door against the permitted walls (strategies A, D, C, B); access_core keeps the door, vestibule, void and the preselected candidates; the drawing is provisional until S2 chooses.

access_core.description: Stage S1.2 access core: main door, swing, vestibule, interior void (strategy C), the candidate drawn and the preselected candidates handed to S2 (provisional until S2 chooses).

stair_core.description: Stage S1.1: the stair as the fixed core stage S2 zones around: configuration, footprint, ends with their arrival zones and receiving spaces (client rules K01, K02), the space under the stair and its use per bottom option (K03, K04), the alternatives per configuration and the D/I/N extension (K05).

open_air.description: S2.2g: open ends of the bands (roof upstairs; porch or unbuilt downstairs).

frame_lines_carried.description: S2.2g: share of the frame lines that are zone walls on the ground floor.

s2.description: Stage S2: zoning of both floors around the stair core. status zoned -> next_stage S2.1 (space level, planned).

stair_choice.description: Stage S1.2 decision in S2: every preselected stair candidate zoned, the choice in three levels (hard rules, route tolerance, client preferences), the Pareto front (route, occupied area) and the best candidate of each strategy (portfolio).

ranked.description: Every zoned candidate in choice order (lets the tolerance be simulated from the contract).

frame.description: S2.2g: the structural frame both floors are zoned on (framed), or why not (failed: no frame zones the cell and the frame rule is hard; fallback: free zoning, frame rule soft; none: no frame fits the upper floor).

s21_door.description: A door or opening of stage S2.1: a = the space the leaf swings into (or the first space of an opening); segment on the shared wall (world coordinates); hinge and swing (quarter disc) for hinged doors; garage doors self-closing (O02).

cap_sqft.description: S2.2e: effective maximum net area of the space (area criteria of the program adjustment).

under_stair_sqft.description: S2.2j: area of a half bath under the stair that the stair covers (the space is drawn whole).

patio_exit.description: Secondary door of the ground floor (stage S2.1b): space, facade, kind, width, glass area, landing (R311.3), whether the landing meets the rear deck.

open_air.description: Step S2.2d: the part of an upper unit its spaces at optimal areas leave: lower roof, or a terrace (at most the registry depth) serving a room.

hall_trim.description: S2.2h (upper floor): the hall trimmed to what it serves: dead end before and after, linen closet, closets of the rooms, roof, area joined to rooms, distance of the bedroom doors to the stair landing; applied false with the reason when a check failed.

stair_opening.description: S2.2i (upper floor): what the floor leaves open over the stair (the footprint less the covered first treads).

stair_covered_sqft.description: S2.2i: stair footprint the upper floor covers (headroom kept under it).

stair_cover.description: S2.2i: the covered stair start as a closet of the space beside it (applied, host, sq ft).

in_room.description: S2.2j: per bedroom, whether a bed with its clearances fits off the door swings and approaches with every doorway reached around it (R3), and the distance from the entry doorway to the inner doorways (R2).

strips.description: S2.2j: strips narrower than their least width joined to a neighbour or made closets, closets too small to open joined to their room, and what was left.

fixtures.description: S2.2j: bath fixtures in line: the wet end (shower or tub) away from the bath closet and the door swing, and the bands of wet zone, toilet and vanity (polygons).

s21.description: Stage S2.1: spaces and doors inside the S2 zones of both floors (closes step 6.7a). status spaced -> next_stage null; no_valid_layout keeps the first violation; not_evaluated when no candidate was zoned.

site.description: Front yard and main entry (stage S2.1b): driveway, walkway, entry deck, garden (world polygons), main door with sidelight, areas, paving fraction and the Z10 / Z11 / O04 / O05 checks.

k10.description: Baths per bedroom (K10): en-suite baths and baths shared between two bedrooms.

structure.description: S2.2f: how the upper floor stands on the ground floor: zone walls, all walls (partitions), bearing spans (joist direction, largest span), unsupported stretches and posts.

arrival.description: S2.2f: per floor, connected circulation pieces, short side of the space receiving the stair and the bedroom doors' spread and route from the stair end (ft).

frame.description: S2.2g: the frame's axes, how the ground floor carries them (wall or beam, posts), upper walls on ground walls and the open ends of the bands.

roofs.description: S2.2g: roofs in several planes (upper roof, one-story lower roofs, garage and porch roofs) with plate height, slope and top.

program_fallback.description: S2.2j: the program fallback the layout needed (walk_in_to_closet, guest_to_study or both).

fallbacks_tried.description: S2.2j: program fallbacks tried after the program as adjusted had no valid layout, with their outcome.

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 (canonical JSON) of the inputs the producer read (the area_matrix and lot_capacity contracts and the selection mode).

brief_id.description: Brief the contract belongs to (informative; null for a multi-lot plan).

consumers.description: Informative: modules expected to read it (viz, pipeline).

plan.description: Stage S1: lot and envelope polygons (world coordinates, from lot_capacity) so the stacked plans are drawn from this contract alone.

program_adjustment.description: Stage S2.1 program adjustment of the cell (corridor allowance, K10 baths) within the FAR slack.
